name: Strax, Sontaran Nurse
oracle_text:
Vigilance, trample
Grenades! — {2}, {T}, Sacrifice an artifact: Choose a player at random. When you do, Strax fights another target creature that player controls.
Glory of Battle — Whenever Strax deals damage to a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on Strax.
blocked_sentences: Glory of Battle — Whenever Strax deals damage to a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on Strax.

needs.what: a trigger on the permanent half of DAMAGE_DEALT whose subject is the DEALER (source: "self" = this creature dealt it) and which fires only when the recipient is a creature -- e.g. `deals_damage_to_creature`, or a recipient filter (`recipient: {types: ["Creature"]}`) on `deals_damage` -- for "Whenever this creature deals damage to a creature" (combat, fight or any other damage)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `deals_damage` takes the dealer as subject but covers both halves (players, planeswalkers, battles, creatures) and its `filter` reads only the dealer, so damage to a player alone would add a counter. `dealt_damage` has the creature victim as subject but no key naming the dealer; its `damaged_by: "self"` filter reads the per-turn damage ledger, so another source damaging a creature Strax hit earlier this turn would also fire it. `deals_combat_damage` misses the fight from Grenades!, and the `fights` trigger misses combat damage and fires on a 0-power fight. No condition_key or binding exposes the event's recipient type. The Grenades! line itself is expressible (cost mana+tap+sacrifice Artifact; choose_player random over each_player as a binding; reflexive_trigger whose target selector uses controller {binding}, exclude_self, then fight).
